_comment: Settings for the automatic season snapshot. Fill in every REPLACE-ME. The anon key is safe to keep in a public repo - it is already public in your website's code.
_divisions_comment: If your table has a column that says which division a row belongs to, put its name in divisionColumn and the exact values it uses below. If you only track combined standings, leave divisionColumn as an empty string and all rows will go into Combined.
